how_to_use: 1. Edit this file to add, update or remove birds
2. Put your photo in: public/images/birds/  OR use a full Cloudinary URL
3. For image_url: use full Cloudinary URL  e.g. https://res.cloudinary.com/ddanljhjx/image/upload/v.../photo.jpg
4. For video_url: use Cloudinary Public ID only  e.g. birds/my_bird_video
5. Run:  node import-birds.js  to push all changes live to Supabase

field_guide.id: Unique number — shown on the card. Do not repeat.
field_guide.name: Common name of the bird  e.g. Budgerigar Parrots
field_guide.species: Breed or type  e.g. Budgerigar Parrots, Bangla
field_guide.description: Short description shown on the card
field_guide.image_url: Full Cloudinary URL or local path like public/images/birds/photo.jpg
field_guide.image_url_tip: For iPhone photos (.heic) add f_jpg after /upload/ — e.g: .../upload/f_jpg/v123.../photo.heic
field_guide.price: e.g. BDT 250  or  Contact for price

birds.name: Budgerigar Parrots
birds.description: Highly intelligent and great as a companion bird.
